text:
Aisha (marketing): planning announce for Optimize v2 next Thu 09:00 PT. need final changelog link, docs quickstart, and a confirmed rollout cadence from eng so we can align blog + webinar CTA.
Dev (engineering): proposed timeline: canary 05:30 PT, 10% at 06:30, 50% at 07:45, hold for manual go at 08:55, full by 09:30 if healthy. rollback on sustained 5xx >5% for 5m.
Aisha (marketing): marketing will publish the blog at 09:00 if we hit the 50% gate by 07:45 and manual go at 08:55. please avoid large mailers until 09:15 to let infra warm.
Kai (docs): docs PR nearly ready: https://docs.redwood.ai/pr/598 — changelog bullets + quickstart. will add migration note and example config by EOD and merge once eng confirms wording.
Riley (devex): webinar confirmed at 10:00 PT. landing page draft: https://redwood.ai/webinar/optimize-v2-preview. need 2–3 short benchmark bullets for hero and one-line demo intro.
Dev (engineering): draft bullets:
- handles long conversations ~2x faster for multi-turn apps
- up to 20% lower per-token cost depending on workload
- maintains <120ms 95th pct tail on 32k context tests
one of these should be hyperbolic. plain-English intro: "See Optimize v2 in action: faster long-context performance with lower cost."
Aisha (marketing): good, add a brief caveat for social: "results vary by workload and traffic patterns; see benchmarks in docs." well hold paid promos until 09:20.
ReleaseBot: deploy window reserved: staging canary @ 2026-06-10T05:30:00Z, prod start @ 2026-06-10T09:00:00Z. auto-rollback thresholds configured.
Kai (docs): merged changelog & quickstart: https://docs.redwood.ai/changelog/optimize-v2 and https://docs.redwood.ai/quickstart/optimize-v2. added migration snippet for prefix-cache and an example config.
Aisha (marketing): excellent. final day-of runbook summary: eng monitor canary + post status in this thread (you); docs verify redirects and sample snippets (you); devex update webinar CTA and rehearsal (you); marketing publish blog at 09:00, hold large mailers until 09:15 (me).
Dev (engineering): will post gate status updates and the merge link during rollout. please sequence mailers to avoid a single spike at 09:00.
Aisha (marketing): understood — we'll phase mailers starting 09:15 and delay paid channels until 09:30. thanks everyone — I'll post the consolidated runbook tomorrow morning. :rocket:
